title: Joining Things Together
label: ch:ml-cherkkuka
canDo: I can put two or more nouns in one list, and offer somebody a choice between two, using the ending Malayalam puts on each item rather than a word between them.

payoff.summary: From cold: water and rice, tea or coffee, and a three-item list carrying three endings.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three, with nothing open in front of the reader.
